'''Joan Beringer''' (born 11 November 2006) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]] of the [[ABA League]].

==Early life==
Beringer was born on 11 November 2006,<ref name="FIBA Basketball">{{cite web |title=Joan Beringer (France) - Basketball Stats, Height, Age |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/players/367077-joan-beringer |website=FIBA Basketball |access-date=7 March 2025}}</ref> in [[Sélestat]], France.<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{cite web |title=How to go first time playing to projected first round draft pick in 3 years? Ask Joan Beringer - FIBA U19 Basketball World Cup 2025 |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u19-basketball-world-cup-2025/news/how-to-go-first-time-playing-to-projected-first-round-draft-pick-in-3-years |website=FIBA Basketball |access-date=7 March 2025 |date=7 February 2025 |quote=Beringer was born in Sélestat, where he lived until he was 10 and moved to Strasbourg.}}</ref> He spent the first 10 years of his life in Sélestat before moving to [[Strasbourg]]. He played [[Association football|football]] growing up, and by the summer of 2021 had "never even touched a [[basketball]]."<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/joan-beringer-le-nouvel-ovni-francais-un-premier-tour-de-draft-nba-faconne-en-moins-de-quatre-ans|website=BeBasket.fr|language=French|title=Joan Beringer, le nouvel OVNI français : un premier tour de Draft NBA façonné en moins de quatre ans ?!|trans-title=Joan Beringer, the new French UFO: a first round of NBA Draft shaped in less than four years?!|author=Lacoste, Alexandre|date=23 January 2025}}</ref> However, he said that "At around 14-15 years old, I couldn't find [[Football boot|cleats]] in my size, my feet were too big."<ref name="auto"/> After being pressured by friends, he tried out basketball for the first time and enjoyed the sport. He later joined the club Strasbourg Saint-Joseph Basket and played for the U17 team.<ref name="auto"/>

Beringer joined [[SIG Strasbourg]] in 2022 and played for their U18 squad in the {{ill|LNB Espoirs|fr|Championnat de France de basket-ball Espoirs}} league, averaging 4.1 points in the 2022–23 season then 17.4 poins in 2023–24. He also played for the U21 prospects team and averaged 9.4 points, 8.0 rebounds and 1.5 assists.<ref name="auto"/>

==Professional career==
Beringer moved to [[Ljubljana]] in the summer of 2024 to join the club [[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]]. He was initially set to play for the club's reserve squad, but impressed and was promoted to the senior team before having appeared in a game.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cedevita.olimpija.com/en/joan-beringer-signs-first-professional-contract/|publisher=[[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]]|title=Joan Beringer Signs First Professional Contract|date=19 November 2024}}</ref> In November 2024, he signed a four-year contract with Cedevita.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.dna.fr/sport/2024/11/19/le-selestadien-joan-beringer-signe-son-premier-contrat-pro-avec-ljubljana|newspaper=[[Les Dernières Nouvelles d'Alsace]]|language=French|trans-title=Alsatian Joan Beringer signs his first professional contract with Ljubljana|title=L'Alsacien Joan Beringer signe son premier contrat pro avec Ljubljana|date=19 November 2024}}</ref> He saw significant playing time and helped them win the [[Slovenian Basketball Cup]] for the 2024–25 season.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/une-emotion-enorme-joan-beringer-soffre-son-premier-trophee-professionnel|website=BeBasket.fr|language=French|title="Une émotion énorme" : Joan Beringer s'offre son premier trophée professionel!|trans-title=“A huge emotion”: Joan Beringer wins his first professional trophy!|date=20 February 2025|author=Lacoste, Alexandre}}</ref>

Beringer has been considered a potential selection in the [[2025 NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-france-joan-beringer|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: France's Joan Beringer|date=29 October 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/joan-beringer-skillset-nba-defensive-anchor-draft|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=Joan Beringer Has the Skillset To Become the Defensive Anchor NBA Teams Desire|date=29 January 2025|author=Bernucca, Andrew}}</ref>

==International career==
Beringer competed for France at the [[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship]].<ref name="auto"/>
